name: design-harness
description: Review before show for UI work: a Stop hook holds any turn that changed rendered files until a fresh-context reviewer has compared the change with its sibling surfaces, the project's settled rules and the AI-look register, and checked copy length, token drift, accessibility, line breaks and layout. An art-direction critic judges a page's taste against references the designer picked and their past picks, and answers with directions to try on the page. Plus a mood-board kickoff and a learn skill that turns corrections into rules and picks into a record. Ships inspo, real production websites over MCP, as a reference source.
